painPoints.title: Backup and self-consumption demand
painPoints.description: Homeowners want reliable backup and better use of solar generation, while dealers need packages that are easy to explain.

painPoints.title: Dealer-ready product education
painPoints.description: Residential sales teams need simple language, diagrams and FAQ content to help customers understand solar-plus-storage value.

painPoints.title: Consistent package configuration
painPoints.description: Repeatable module, inverter and battery combinations reduce quoting mistakes and support faster dealer training.

solutionApproach: Position home storage around practical packages that combine solar modules with battery capacity and installation guidance. Use FAQ, downloads and solution pages to help dealers answer common buyer objections before the inquiry stage.
buyerChecklist: Daily electricity use or bill range
Backup loads and required backup hours

faqs.question: Is this for homeowners or B2B dealers?
faqs.answer: The website targets B2B dealers and installers who sell home solar-plus-storage packages to local residential customers.

faqs.question: Which system pages should this application connect to?
faqs.answer: It should connect to grid-tied solar storage and smaller off-grid packages so buyers can compare backup and self-consumption options.

ctaTitle: Building a home storage product line?
